about:
Corvia Medical is based in Tewksbury, Massachusetts. The company has been led since 2010 by President and CEO George Fazio, a veteran of the medical device industry with prior leadership roles at St. Jude Medical. The leadership team includes Chief Medical Officer Jan Komtebedde, Vice President of R&D and Operations Ed McNamara, and Vice President of Quality Assurance and Regulatory Affairs Kate Stohlman.

The company is focused on developing an investigational medical device aimed at transforming the standard of care for heart failure treatment. The device is currently limited to investigational use under United States law. Corvia Medical’s operations span research and development, clinical strategy, regulatory affairs, and quality assurance, with a team experienced in cardiovascular device development from prototype through commercialization.

Corvia Medical operates in the cardiovascular medical device sector, targeting heart failure treatment. Its investigational device is being evaluated through clinical trials, with the aim of serving interventional cardiologists and healthcare systems once approved.

The company was built on the collective experience of its leadership team, which brings decades of expertise in structural heart and interventional cardiology devices from companies such as St. Jude Medical, Abbott Vascular, and Medtronic. This background informs Corvia’s approach to developing novel therapies for heart failure.
